definitions.explanation: A small platform or stool used to reach high places or to step up onto something.
Something or someone used as a means to achieve one's own goals. Often has a negative connotation when referring to using people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{踏|ふ}み{台|だい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I used a step stool to reach a high place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}える→洗う：00827_arau⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{洗面台|せんめんだい}→洗面台：04988_senmendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{踏|ふ}み{台|だい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I put a step stool in front of the sink so the child can wash their hands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{台|だい}にして⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Climb the ladder by using others as stepping stones.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{台|だい}にして⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だ。
examples.english: I plan to use this job as a stepping stone to move on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{台|だい}にして⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think he succeeded by using me as a stepping stone.

notes:
{踏|ふ}み{台|だい} refers both to physical step stools and figuratively to stepping stones for advancement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {踏|ふ}み{台|だい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (use as a stepping stone)
- {踏|ふ}み{台|だい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (stand on a step stool)
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{台|だい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (use someone as a stepping stone)

USAGE NOTE: When used figuratively (sense 2), especially with people, this word often carries a negative connotation of exploiting others for personal gain.
